name: Yukisaki Erena
source:
Hobbies: Writing erotic novels
Likes: Junk food such as cup ramen, reading, snow
Dislikes: Summer (not good with the heat), using home appliances
Penname: ??? [spoiler]Dosukebe Bitch (ドスケベビッチ), COLORLESS[/spoiler]

[url=/c98086]Toshiki's[/url] senpai who is part of the novelist department. A beautiful girl with silvery platinum blonde hair. She is one-quarter Japanese due to her grandmother being from Northern Europe. 

At first glance, she looks pretty stoic and mysterious. However, she is not a taciturn type and often reacts to her friends' jokes or conversations with unrelated or otherwise weird remarks.

Her hobby is writing erotic novels. However, when Toshiki read them for the first time, he doubted whether Erena is truly part of the novelist department due to how poorly written they were.

Nevertheless, her occasional sharp remarks suggest that there is more to her than meets the eye .......
